boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 94 is a four-chamber cascade: `14` and `18` on top, a horizontal `6` bar through the middle, and a tucked-away `3` pocket in the lower-right. Open the lower clutter first, cash the `3` and `6` chambers second, and only then settle into the long `14` and `18` feeds.
landmarks: Block Out Level 94 is a four-chamber cascade: `14` and `18` on top, a horizontal `6` bar through the middle, and a tucked-away `3` pocket in the lower-right.
Open the lower clutter first, cash the `3` and `6` chambers second, and only then settle into the long `14` and `18` feeds.
The board mixes Purple, Red, Green and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The lower-right `3` pocket is not optional cleanup. It is part of the opener.
If the `6` bar is still alive, the `18` chamber is probably not ready yet.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the lower-left clutter first, especially the lock/key pieces and the red-green stacks around the bottom chambers.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Open and drain the lower-right `3` chamber so the right quarter finally has rotation space.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Reduce the middle `6` chamber next, using the newly opened lower lanes to keep the cross-lane clear.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Start feeding the upper-left `14` chamber once the lower half is no longer sharing its lanes.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Save the upper-right `18` chamber for the longest late-game feed, when the cyan T-shape and purple elbow below have already moved aside.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the last cyan and purple leftovers after the `18` chamber collapses.

failurePoints: Ignoring the lower-right `3` pocket and pretending Level 94 only has three chambers.
Starting the `18` chamber while the middle `6` bar is still competing for the same lane.
